text:
maria: Heads-up: p50 latency spike on dedicated us-west-2 pool (small-chat) starting ~08:12. p50 40ms -> 220ms, p95 ~1.2s. Traces point to long kernel compile/selection times.

derek: Looking. Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/abcd/provisioning?orgId=1&from=1717845000&to=1717845400 — I can see the spike correlates with a provisioning window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: kernel-optimizer rollout v5.3 completed on pool-3 at 08:05 (rollout 30%).

tanvi: Could be warm-pool eviction churn + kernel fallback. Any warm-pool scale events around 08:00-08:10?

li: Yes — autoscaler logs show warm_pool_size went 20 -> 5 at 08:03 due to host_reclaim during infra maintenance. Log snippet: `2026-03-07T08:03:12Z scale_down_reason=host_reclaim pool=pool-3 warm_size=5`.

ashley: If warm pool dropped, incoming requests likely hit cold-start path: JIT kernel selection and optional LLVM compile which adds 100-400ms per first-request. Do we have a perf dump?

derek: Uploaded perf dump: s3://perf-dumps/1717845123/profile.pb. Quick flame shows hotspots in `select_kernels()` and `llvm_jit_compile`. Also see elevated time in `batch_scheduler::recompute_batching` while kernels are missing.

maria: KV cache warming also appears affected — similar prefixes not hitting KV because sessions were evicted during reclaim. So requests hit both kernel compile and cache-miss penalties, compounding the latency.

tanvi: Workaround options: rollback v5.3 on the affected pool (if kernel change exacerbated compile paths) and temporarily raise min_warm_size to avoid future aggressive reclaim. Thoughts?

li: Starting rollback on pool-3: `deployctl rollback kernel-optimizer v5.2 --pool pool-3`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated 08:20, 0/6 nodes done.

derek: Also proposing a temporary autoscaler override: `min_warm_size=10` for us-west-2 pools to stop immediate eviction while we investigate. I'll push that change.

ashley: I'll open an incident ticket (INC-2026-0317) with attached profile, autoscaler logs, and a reproduction recipe. Assigning to eng-runtime for kernel selection triage.

maria: Thanks — reassign derek for triage, tanvi to own autoscaler policy change, ashley to incident doc. Ping @oncall if we see recurrence after rollback.

derek: :thumbsup: Will post a follow-up with root cause (kernel selection fallback vs rollout bug) and a timeline once we have the full trace analysis and build timestamps.
